content: विश् €6 <ab>P.</ab> (विशति, विवेश, अविक्षत् वेक्ष्यति, वेष्टुम्, विष्ट) .²1 To enter, go or enter into; यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः <ls>Bg. 11. 29</ls>; भोक्तुमन्तःपुरं विशेत् <ls>Ms. 7. 216</ls>; विवेश कश्चिज्जटिलस्तपोवनम् <ls>Ku. 5. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 10</ls>; <ls>Me. 104</ls>; so दोलायमानेन चेतसा चिन्तां विवेश <ls>K. 199</ls> ‘fell a-thinking’. .²2 To go or come to, come into the possession of, fall to the share of; उपदा विविशुः शश्वन्नोत्सेकाः कोशलेश्वरम् <ls>R. 4. 70</ls>. .²3 To sit or settle down upon. .²4 To penetrate, pervade. .²5 To enter upon, undertake. .²6 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) To come into conjunction with. .²7 To appear on the stage. .²8 To flow into (as a river or army); तत्सेना नरनाथानां पृतनाभिः पदे पदे . कुलापगेव कुल्याभिर्विशन्तीभिरवर्धत .. <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 140</ls>. .²9 To befall (a death). .²10 To belong to, exist for. .²11 To mind, attend to (any business); <ls>Mb. 12</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (वेशयति-ते) To cause to enter. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (विविक्षति) To wish to enter.

विश् {%m.%} .²1 A man of the third caste, a Vaiśya. .²2 A man in general. .²3 People. --{%f.%} .²1 People, subjects; शश्वद्येषु विशामनन्यविषयो रक्षाधिकारः स्थितः <ls>Mv. 1. 25</ls>. .²2 A daughter; <ls>Ms. 3. 148</ls>. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> Entrance. .²4 A family, tribe, race. .²5 A settlement, dwelling. .²6 (<ab>pl.</ab>) Property, wealth.
